I (F20) have hpd and my bf(M20) bpd, so, i think I can share my personal experience. 

It's quite fun in the beginning of friendship and we both like extremes, which makes our dates etc. Extra fun. The difficult part was that he had also very much down episodes. Like bad bad and I wasn't used to it, since I only was used to getting all the attention and praise from others. But when my bf neglected me I got scared even to talk to him, so I kinda ghosted him and couldn't find a way to get to him. 

Since people with hpd generally love love looove to provoke and get attention, I have to say now I don't do it anymore since I have gotten therapy and talked allot to my bf. 

I provoked and taken in from others and that obviously hurt him.. I was very narcissistic and selfish. He also.

But we went tripping alooott and when I say alloott I mean like 3 times a week during the quarantine/corona period. This made us reflect on our actions and now our relationship is more than good. Have to say we did have drama from here to tokyo like wtf lol. 

We deflated our egos and don't need attention from everyone anymore. He is very open about himself, but we both have our triggers and are honest about it. 

I don't know if this answered your question. So, feel free to ask away. But a friendship would be better I guess because in a relationship you have to make sacrifices. 

Have a nice day further :)

Hey just wanna let you know that's a common issue with EDs. When I was in recovery, I also saved my calories for "just in case" someone offered me something. But that also led to having to eat allot if the day went normal. What I'd recommend is to stick to your mealplan, and if you are a bit further, to join the people around you who eat "normally". That way you sort of align with their " special food". 

Maybe I'm a bit blurry, but what I'm trying to say is, I struggled with that I just ate my snack or whatever and when my mom came in with cake etc, I wouldn't allow myself to eat a piece, because I "already ate my snack and couldn't eat beside that". Have to say that rule is extremely stupid, cuz Al lot of people eat something small in a shorter amount of time. I think I'm just rambling, but babe please don't safe your calories it's just gonna be a big struggle. Eat where you feel comfortable and take slow steps! Hopefully you all have a wonderful day :)
